title: A blocking gate added on an item moves its run state to blocked with the gate's id, so the orchestrator and the operator learn of it before the worker returns
goal: backlog.py gate add of a blocking gate on an item whose run state is working moves run/<id> to blocked with the field gates naming every open blocking gate of the item, also when the command runs in a worker's worktree on work/<id>, whose coord store is the clone's; answering the last open blocking gate moves it back to working while the worker's recorded pid runs, else to returned

run:
import subprocess, tempfile, os, shutil, re, sys, json, glob
R = os.getcwd(); T = tempfile.mkdtemp(); S = os.path.join(tempfile.mkdtemp(), 'c.sqlite')
env = dict(os.environ, KB_COORD_STORE=S)
def sh(*a): return subprocess.run(a, cwd=T, capture_output=True, text=True, env=env)
g = lambda *a: sh('git', '-c', 'user.email=a@b', '-c', 'user.name=n', *a)
g('init', '-q', '.'); g('commit', '-q', '--allow-empty', '-m', 'init')
shutil.copy(R + '/backlog.json', T); os.makedirs(T + '/kb/_self/backlog')
bl = lambda *a: sh(sys.executable, R + '/_tools/backlog.py', '--root', T, *a)
def c(*a): return subprocess.run([sys.executable, R + '/_tools/coord.py', '--store', S, *a], capture_output=True, text=True)
sp = re.search(r'SP-\w+', bl('new', 'sprint', '--title', 'S', '--goal', 'g').stdout).group(0)
iid = re.search(r'ST-\w+', bl('new', 'story', '--title', 'Planted', '--goal', 'g', '--check', 'python3 -c pass').stdout).group(0)
def plant(status):
    for f in glob.glob(T + '/kb/_self/backlog/*.json'):
        d = json.load(open(f, encoding='utf-8'))
        if d['id'] == sp: d['status'] = 'active'
        if d['id'] == iid: d['status'] = status; d['sprint'] = sp
        json.dump(d, open(f, 'w', encoding='utf-8'), indent=2)
    g('add', '-A'); g('commit', '-q', '-m', 'planted ' + status)
def walk(*states): return [c('transition', 'run/' + iid, '--to', s).returncode for s in states]
plant('doing')
walk('claimed', 'working')
r = bl('gate', 'add', iid, '--question', 'Which default?', '--option', 'a', '--option', 'b', '--recommendation', 'a', '--kind', 'blocking')
try:
    ev = json.loads(c('wait', '--since', '0', '--timeout', '0').stdout)['events']
except ValueError:
    ev = []
last = [e['fields'] for e in ev if e['kind'] == 'progress' and e['fields'].get('item') == iid][-1:]
ok = r.returncode == 0 and 'blocked' in c('get', 'run/' + iid).stdout and last and last[0].get('state') == 'blocked' and last[0].get('gates') == 'g1'
print('gate add', r.returncode, 'last progress', last)
sys.exit(0 if ok else 1)

import subprocess, tempfile, os, shutil, re, sys, json, glob
R = os.getcwd(); T = tempfile.mkdtemp(); S = os.path.join(tempfile.mkdtemp(), 'c.sqlite')
env = dict(os.environ, KB_COORD_STORE=S)
def sh(*a): return subprocess.run(a, cwd=T, capture_output=True, text=True, env=env)
g = lambda *a: sh('git', '-c', 'user.email=a@b', '-c', 'user.name=n', *a)
g('init', '-q', '.'); g('commit', '-q', '--allow-empty', '-m', 'init')
shutil.copy(R + '/backlog.json', T); os.makedirs(T + '/kb/_self/backlog')
bl = lambda *a: sh(sys.executable, R + '/_tools/backlog.py', '--root', T, *a)

sp = re.search(r'SP-\w+', bl('new', 'sprint', '--title', 'S', '--goal', 'g').stdout).group(0)

pid from the claims ledger of this working tree only; a second gate is not announced

notes: Premise: gate add of a blocking gate exits 0 and posts nothing to coord (the check finds no progress event). A worker's gate lives only in the item file on work/<id> (kb/_self/backlog.md:333) and reaches the orchestrator when it reads the branch after the worker returns (.claude/skills/kb-sprint/SKILL.md:55); on 2026-10-23 such gates reached the operator only through chat questions after each worker finished. Plan 2026-10-24: premise reproduced on base (precheck: gate add exits 0, last progress event is still working). Second check added for the answer move back (returned when no worker pid is recorded). The branch where the recorded worker pid runs (back to working) and the gate add run in a worker's worktree on work/<id> are not read by a check; implement them as the goal says.
